items.title: Add the Host DONE convergence / drift-handling section to CLAUDE.md
items.context: Add a new section 'Host DONE convergence / drift handling' to CLAUDE.md covering these rules (a projection of existing mechanisms, with references): (1) TEST->DONE: run `lattice done_prepare --storyId=B-xxxx --mergeMain --refreshStale --validate` BEFORE story_advance DONE, never collide story_advance DONE directly. (2) Host does not self-judge freshness; read the done_prepare / freshness-reader classification, not raw hashes. (3) headHash-only drift is usually metadata/provenance movement, not a strong rerun signal. (4) materialHash-only drift with unchanged storyFilesHash is an unrelated whole-tree drift candidate; per the current consumer contract it may be advisory / re-attestation / refresh rather than full re-quorum -- VERBATIM: 'materialHash-only drift with unchanged storyFilesHash is usually unrelated whole-tree drift. In current warn/advisory paths, Lattice may downgrade this to re-attestation advisory instead of forcing full re-review/quorum. Host must follow done_prepare / freshness-reader output, not self-classify it as pass.' (5) storyFilesHash drift is the strong story-owned-material signal; review pass / quorum / delivery may need re-binding (consumer-dependent: reviewer-pass is strict, floor/escalation/delivery-check downgrade on storyFilesHash-unchanged). (6) done_prepare automates merge/refresh/validate/next-action but does NOT bypass related drift. (7) metadata-only dirty handling -- VERBATIM pointer: 'Metadata-only dirty handling is governed by done_prepare/lifecycle_check; see B-9dfb once merged. Host must not manually bypass cleanTree.' Reference these decision docs (verified to exist): docs/requirements/decisions/proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md, story-files-hash-material-drift.md, done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md, review-assurance-floor-execution-plan.md, plus `lattice done_prepare --help`. Do NOT restate the rules from those docs; cite them as the source of truth to avoid docs-drift.

happy.desc: grep -c 'Host DONE convergence' CLAUDE.md returns >= 1 -> section heading exists; WHY: confirms the required section was added to CLAUDE.md

grep -F 'materialHash-only drift with unchanged storyFilesHash is usually unrelated whole-tree drift' CLAUDE.md returns match -> VERBATIM paragraph 1 present; WHY: checklist mandates exact wording for materialHash-only downgrade rule

grep -F 'Metadata-only dirty handling is governed by done_prepare/lifecycle_check; see B-9dfb once merged' CLAUDE.md returns match -> VERBATIM paragraph 2 (metadata-only pointer) present; WHY: checklist mandates exact wording for metadata-only pointer

grep -c 'proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan' CLAUDE.md returns >= 1 AND grep -c 'story-files-hash-material-drift' CLAUDE.md returns >= 1 AND grep -c 'done-prepare-automation-execution-plan' CLAUDE.md returns >= 1 AND grep -c 'review-assurance-floor-execution-plan' CLAUDE.md returns >= 1 -> all 4 decision-doc references present; WHY: the section must cite all 4 verified decision docs

grep -F 'lattice done_prepare' CLAUDE.md within the new section returns match -> done_prepare command is mentioned as the automation entry point; WHY: rule (1) requires documenting that hosts run done_prepare before story_advance DONE

edge.desc: The section cites decision docs as source-of-truth rather than restating their full rule sets inline -> no invented rules or rule restating that could drift from the canonical docs; WHY: story description explicitly says 'Do NOT restate the rules from those docs; cite them as the source of truth to avoid docs-drift'

Run docs-drift preflight (if available, e.g. lattice validate or git diff --stat on decision docs) to confirm no decision-doc content was duplicated into CLAUDE.md -> preflight stays green; WHY: guards against the exact docs-drift antipattern the story warns about

adversarial.desc: Inspect the new section for any CLI behavior claims (e.g., 'this command will ...', 'running X produces Y output') that go beyond referencing existing docs/help -> none found; WHY: story scope is docs-only, no CLI/code/behavior claims allowed; leaked behavior claims would create a maintenance liability

Verify the section does not introduce NEW rules beyond the 7 enumerated in the checklist context (rules 1-7) -> no novel policy invented; WHY: story description says 'a projection/reference of existing rules, NOT new rules'
